savedTextArtifacts.inventory.py:
import argparse
import csv
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Print inventory as JSON or CSV.")
    parser.add_argument("items", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--format", choices=("json", "csv"), default="json")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    records = json.loads(args.items.read_text())
    if args.format == "csv":
        writer = csv.DictWriter(sys.stdout, fieldnames=("id", "name", "quantity"))
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(records)
    else:
        print(json.dumps(records))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import csv,io,json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent
phase=sys.argv[1]
out=p/('evidence-'+phase)
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
runs=[]
def run(label,args):
    command=['python3','inventory.py']+args
    r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=p,capture_output=True)
    (out/(label+'.stdout')).write_bytes(r.stdout)
    (out/(label+'.stderr')).write_bytes(r.stderr)
    runs.append(dict(label=label,command=command,returncode=r.returncode,stdout=str(out/(label+'.stdout')),stderr=str(out/(label+'.stderr'))))
    return r
j=run('default',['items.json'])
c=run('csv',['items.json','--format','csv'])
expected=[{'id':'00123','name':'Washer, large','quantity':'3'},{'id':'00999','name':'Bracket "A"','quantity':'0'}]
checks={'default_json':j.returncode==0 and json.loads(j.stdout)==json.loads((p/'items.json').read_text()),'csv_contract':c.returncode==0 and list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(c.stdout.decode())))==expected}
if phase=='after':
    checks['default_bytes_unchanged']=j.stdout==(p/'evidence-before/default.stdout').read_bytes()
    e=run('explicit-json',['items.json','--format','json'])
    checks['explicit_json']=e.returncode==0 and e.stdout==j.stdout
    bad=run('invalid-format',['items.json','--format','xml'])
    checks['invalid_format']=bad.returncode==2 and not bad.stdout
    (out/'empty.json').write_text('[]')
    empty=run('empty',[str(out/'empty.json'),'--format','csv'])
    checks['empty_header']=empty.returncode==0 and empty.stdout==b'id,name,quantity\r\n'
    data=[{'id':'00000','name':'Line\n"quoted", café','quantity':1}]
    (out/'edge.json').write_text(json.dumps(data))
    edge=run('edge',[str(out/'edge.json'),'--format','csv'])
    checks['edge_roundtrip']=edge.returncode==0 and list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(edge.stdout.decode())))==[dict(data[0],quantity='1')]
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps({'runs':runs,'checks':checks},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(checks))
if phase=='after' and not all(checks.values()): sys.exit(1)
